author: GamingBolt
description:
Metro 2033 Redux next-gen update never completely overcomes the antiquated design choices integral to the moment-to-moment gameplay. This results in an experience that feels closer to witnessing a time capsule capturing a moment in gaming that is absolutely worth preserving. 

For newcomers who have always curious about the Metro series, this is a great excuse to check it out. Long time fans of the series will definitely appreciate the technical improvements, but if you are expecting a substantial overhaul, you may be left somewhat disappointed.
title: Metro 2033 Redux Next-Gen Update PS5 Review - Still Worth Playing, Quirks And All

author: GamingBolt
description:
I previously spoke about one of Phantom Blade Zero's biggest strengths: its accessibility. The difficulty options, the free resource recovery when reverting weapons, up to level 10, at least, the boss checkpoints – if you're someone who's in it to quite literally win it, then S-Game has you covered. Because at the end of the day, the focus is on making you feel like a kung fu master who can absolutely wipe the floor with his enemies.

But what if you wanted the lore-accurate experience of Soul fleeing from the Order, the days ticking down until his inevitable death? What if you sought the rush of actual feasible danger because it could directly affect your chances of completing the game? And no, I'm not talking about going on a moonlit walk on Hellwalker difficulty. Instead, the answer is 66 Days Mode.
title: Phantom Blade Zero Is At Its BEST In 66 Days Mode

author: GamingBolt
description:
GTA 6 is almost here, but its promos continue to be as fascinating as they were when Rockstar finally began telling more about what it had been working on for more than a decade since the franchise’s last title. We’ve weathered a year of delay too, and a new preview from Edge/Gamesradar has surfaced that has us thinking that our patience is about to be rewarded.

We’ve become fixated on how something as simple as committing a crime in Leonidas can become the catalyst for a romp through the city’s streets that you never saw coming. We’re diving into a lot of the new information, and into how it could be a version of GTA that isn’t afraid to try and hold you accountable for your actions in as many ways as it can.

Note: This video draws on published previews and official footage to explore how its systems could come together. So, we have included some hypothetical scenarios and wishlist ideas, so, remember these are speculation, rather than confirmed features!

title: GTA 6’s BIGGEST Upgrade Could Be What Happens After The Crime
